intro.data: Your toolkit is full: two intermediate objects (Clean Table, Chart) and six machines. A real pipeline is three steps — clean the raw data, chart the clean table, then write the report — so you'll bring in BOTH stepping-stones and the three faithful machines. At every step a look-alike produces junk, and a tempting one-step shortcut promises a report straight from raw data — but it lies. Build the chain that yields the true report and leave the three impostors in the tray.
intro.alchemy: Your toolkit is full: two intermediate objects (Ingot, Tool) and six apparatuses. A real process is three steps — refine the ore, shape the ingot, then cast the alloy — so bring in BOTH stepping-stones and the three faithful apparatuses. At every step a look-alike produces slag, and a one-step shortcut promises an alloy straight from ore — but it lies. Build the true chain and leave the three impostors in the tray.
intro.spellcraft: Your toolkit is full: two intermediate objects (Flame, Beacon) and six runes. A real rite is three steps — tame the spark, kindle the flame, then bind the ward — so bring in BOTH stepping-stones and the three faithful runes. At every step a look-alike produces a dud, and a one-step shortcut promises a ward straight from a spark — but it lies. Build the true rite and leave the three impostors in the tray.
intro.abstract: From a full toolkit, place objects B and C and compose three morphisms A→B→C→D to the goal value. Each stage has a same-typed impostor, and a direct A→D shortcut produces the wrong value. Only the faithful chain works; leave the impostors in the tray.

goal.data: Bring in the two stepping-stones and the right machines, and build the three-step chain that turns raw data into the true report.
goal.alchemy: Bring in the two stepping-stones and the right apparatuses, and build the three-step chain that turns ore into the true alloy.
goal.spellcraft: Bring in the two stepping-stones and the right runes, and build the three-step rite that turns a spark into the true ward.
goal.abstract: Place B and C and the faithful machines, and reach D with the value the goal requires.

afterSuccess.data: You chained all three faithful steps — Parser, Charter, Reporter — and the raw data came out as the true report. Every impostor was the right TYPE but the wrong behavior, and the one-step shortcut produced a bogus report. A correct pipeline is the composite of correct steps: report = h ∘ g ∘ f.
afterSuccess.alchemy: You chained all three faithful steps and the ore came out as the true alloy. Every impostor was the right type but wrong behavior, and the shortcut produced a false alloy. A correct process is the composite of correct steps: h ∘ g ∘ f.
afterSuccess.spellcraft: You chained all three faithful steps and the spark came out as the true ward. Every impostor was the right type but wrong behavior, and the shortcut produced a hollow ward. A correct rite is the composite of correct steps: h ∘ g ∘ f.
afterSuccess.abstract: The faithful composite h ∘ g ∘ f reached the goal value. Type-valid impostors and the A→D shortcut did not. Composition demands the right behavior at every step.

reveal.summary: A multi-step pipeline is a composite h ∘ g ∘ f : A → D. Matching types at each port is necessary but not sufficient — every step must also do the right thing, or the final value is wrong.
reveal.programmerAnalogy: const pipeline = (x: A) => h(g(f(x))) — one wrong stage corrupts the whole result.
